author: Rainstruck
body:
I had this idea the other day while I was on a different server. I was playing a walls game, and when people used chat they had a sort of clan tag next to their name. I thought that would be perfect for Avicus!!! I think that it would take the teams idea to a whole new level, and it would get a lot of the people that just go on the server to also join the Forums!! Click here for an idea of what clans could do and look like. I loved back when the whole teams concept was in play and I kinda want it to continue. 

Please comment below your thoughts on this!
